svg.font-family: Hanken Grotesk, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A table of fourteen rows: what the fixtures declare, how many of it there are, and where each number is read from. Two environments are shipped. A run record has five fields, and enumerating every combination gives 324 rows with no sampling. Seven terminal verdicts exist, and only 23 of the 324 rows belong in the quality denominator. The component forge ships five families holding 337 cases and 5,058 frozen expectations, of which 512 are referee scripts replayed through the real rollout loop and 77 are repair cases. Seventy-six test functions pin the claims. Ten evaluation runs are recorded in the tree across 144 rollouts, all of them for the component forge. No scored run is recorded for the first environment, so nothing here is evidence about how a model performs on it.

g.text: environments

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: two of them
One scores agent-run records into terminal states. The other has
a model write and repair verifiers components against contracts,
and scores what the code does.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: record fields

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: five of them
Execution, provider, oracle, receipt and artifact, with four, three,
three, three and three values. The dataset is their full product
rather than a sample of it.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: dataset records

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 324 rows
Built by taking every combination of the five fields and scoring
each one with the reference scorer, so ground truth is re-derived
rather than stored.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: terminal verdicts

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: seven of them
Verified, refuted, unverifiable, rejected, malformed, timeout and
not launched. The last five are reasons a run leaves the
denominator rather than reasons it failed.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: in the denominator

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Only verified and refuted count. The other 301 rows are
excluded, which is what stops an outage or a blocked launch
from reading as a quality regression.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: forge families

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: five of them
Parser contract, rubric contract, rubric repair, referee protocol
and a synthetic redaction contract that uses fake markers only
and never a real secret.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: forge cases

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 337 in all
96 parser, 96 rubric contract, 77 repair, 64 referee and 4
redaction, each frozen as a data file so a run today and a run
next year draw the same cases.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: frozen expectations

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 5,058 pinned
Probes, fixtures and scripts written ahead of the model rather
than after it. A component is scored against these, not against
the shape of its answer.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: referee scripts

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 512 replayed
Canned player scripts pushed through the real multi-turn rollout
loop. Transcript, reward and stop reason are all compared
against a frozen expectation.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: repair cases

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 77 of them
Each shows one mutated module and its contract. Credit sits on
the probes that separate broken from repaired, so returning the
mutation scores its frozen share.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: pinned tests

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 76 declared
Thirteen on the record scorer and sixty-three on the forge. They
pin exhaustiveness, deterministic rebuilds, reward
discrimination and the redaction guarantee.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: recorded eval runs

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: ten of them
Five forge families against two models, each carrying its own
metadata with the reward, the metrics, the sampling arguments
and the commit that produced it.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: recorded rollouts

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 144 in all
Counted from the result lines of those ten runs rather than from
the requested example count, because a run that ended early
records fewer than it asked for.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: scored runs on mlflow

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: none in the tree
The record-scoring environment has no outputs directory and no
recorded evaluation. Its dataset and scorer are pinned by tests;
no model score is published here.

svg.text: Every count here was read from the module, the frozen data file, the test file or the recorded run that declares it rather than typed in, and
tools/check_repo_facts.py reads those same files. The marked row is the honest null: the dataset and the scorer are pinned by tests, and no model
has a recorded score against the first environment in this repository.
